description: This file defines a React component named CostsOrganizationSummary that displays an organization summary including ID, name, total cost, and user count. It includes loading and error states, uses a mock fetch function for data retrieval, and renders styled UI elements.

methods.name: SummaryItem
methods.description: A React component that renders a label and value pair with optional emphasis styling.

methods.name: mockFetchOrganizationSummary
methods.description: A mock asynchronous function simulating fetching organization summary data, with a chance to throw an error to simulate network failure.

methods.name: delay
methods.description: A utility function that returns a promise resolving after a specified delay in milliseconds.
